lines.trans: The star-studded red-carpet ceremony is about to begin.
Domestic media outlets and enthusiastic audience friends have gathered on site.
Which star do you look forward to most? Let us wait and see.
Everyone from school is here; thank you all so much for helping today!
In a moment have our classmates stand near the front along these two rows.
Please cheer loudly to help us lift the energy on set.
All the Media College students cheering for us are in position.
